newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Christopher news conference on resignation.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Christopher news conference on resignation.

text.p: President Bill Clinton and Secretary of State Warren Christopher are expected to hold a news conference later on Thursday to confirm Christopher's resignation but no appointment of a successor is expected then, U.S. officials said.
"I doubt a successor will be announced then," said one official, referring to the planned news conference at the White House.

U.S. officials reported on Wednesday that Christopher had tendered his resignation but would remain in his post into January, probably until Clinton -- who won re-election on Tuesday -- was inaugurated to a second term on Jan. 20.
The White House news conference was expected to be held at noon EST (1700 GMT).
Christopher discussed his plans with Clinton on Tuesday in Little Rock, Arkansas, Clinton's hometown, where his election night victory celebration was held.
